item.title: Show HN: Marble – A Markdown editor with live preview and collaboration
item.summary: I built marble.md as a collaborative markdown editor - you can share a markdown document by simply sending a link. The problem this solved for me was constantly pasting Markdown design docs back and forth on Google Docs when collaborating with my colleagues. Spent an unreasonable amount of time making loading and editing feel great. Give it a try – feedback welcome : - ) Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49344921 Points: 3 # Comments: 0
